note: Wren Phonics book plan (b406, 2026-10-07). Maps the 43 shipped books onto the programme schedule by cumulative GPC count, then plans the SLOTS (not the text) for the rest of the library — research identified book volume as the biggest gap against validated programmes (LW ~214 books across Phases 2-5 alone vs our 43). "premise" is a one-line seed for a later build to write from, not finished content. provenance: Wren original, b406, 2026-10-07.

planned_slots.premise: Pip helps a younger creature who is stuck in the pond.
Ned notices the weather changing and gets ready for it in the big oak tree.
Olive builds something out of whatever is lying around in the nest.
Moss has a wobbly plan that does not quite work the first time in the vegetable patch.
Fig finds a strange object and tries to work out what it is in the hedge.
Nell races a friend and learns it was not really about winning in the stream.
Pip collects things for a rainy-day project in the old barn.
Ned gets separated from the others and has to call out in the long grass.
Olive discovers a job too big to do alone and asks for help in the compost heap.
Moss tidies up after a mess somebody else made in the bird table.
Fig waits out a storm somewhere snug in the puddle path.
Nell tries a new food and is surprised by it in the log pile.
Pip follows a trail of clues left by someone else in the window box.
Ned makes a gift for a friend out of found objects in the gravel path.
Olive copies a grown-up's job and gets it a little wrong in the greenhouse.
Moss has to share one thing between several characters in the wall top.
Fig watches something grow over several days in the rain barrel.
Nell solves a problem by listening rather than looking in the washing line.
Pip ends the day proud of something small they did in the garden gate.
